{{Use American English|date=March 2026}}
Like many other academic professional societies, the [[American Statistical Association]] (ASA) uses the title of '''Fellow of the American Statistical Association''' as its highest honorary grade of membership. The designation of ASA Fellow has been a significant honor for more than 100 years. The number of new fellows per year is limited to one third of one percent of the membership of the ASA. To be selected, nominees must have an established reputation and have made outstanding contributions to statistical science. People named as Fellows are listed below.<ref name="ASA Fellows List">{{cite web|url=https://www.amstat.org/ASA/Your-Career/Awards/ASA-Fellows-list.aspx|title=ASA Fellows List|publisher=[[American Statistical Association]]|access-date=July 4, 2021|archive-date=April 25, 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190425013824/https://www.amstat.org/ASA/Your-Career/Awards/ASA-Fellows-list.aspx|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref name="ASA Fellows 2022">{{cite web|url=https://www.amstat.org/docs/default-source/amstat-documents/pdfs/fellows/fellows2022.pdf|title=ASA Fellows 2022|publisher=[[American Statistical Association]]|access-date=July 20, 2022}}</ref><ref name="ASA Fellows 2023">{{cite web|url=https://www.amstat.org/docs/default-source/amstat-documents/pdfs/fellows/Fellows2023.pdf|title=ASA Fellows 2023|publisher=[[American Statistical Association]]|access-date=June 14, 2023}}</ref><ref name="ASA Fellows 2024">{{cite web|url=https://www.amstat.org/docs/default-source/amstat-documents/pdfs/fellows/Fellows2024.pdf|title=ASA Fellows 2024|publisher=[[American Statistical Association]]|access-date=May 31, 2024}}</ref><ref name="ASA Fellows 2025">{{cite web|url=https://www.amstat.org/news-listing/2025/04/21/asa-recognizes-2025-founders-and-fellows|title=ASA Recognizes 2025 Founders and Fellows|publisher=[[American Statistical Association]]|access-date=April 27, 2025}}</ref><ref name="ASA Fellows 2026">{{cite web|url=https://www.amstat.org/news-listing/2026/04/22/asa-recognizes-2026-founders-and-fellows|title=ASA Recognizes 2026 Founders and Fellows|publisher=[[American Statistical Association]]|access-date=May 10, 2026}}</ref>
